title: Access Study Assessing the Safety of Prostate-specific Membrane Antigen Radioligands for Positron Emission Tomography
official: PSMA-PET: Access Study Assessing the Safety of Prostate-specific Membrane Antigen Radioligands for Positron Emission Tomography
summary: The purpose of this study is to make non-approved PSMA radioligands available at CHU de Québec - Université Laval, while assessing their safety. Our hypothesis is that all the PSMA PET radioligand are safe, with a very low incidence of adverse events (AEs). The potential clinical impact of PSMA-PET will be explored in our clinical setting.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1\. Reception of a procedure request for PSMA-PET

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Incapacity to provide informed consent
2. Pregnancy, unless there has been a discussion between the participant and a nuclear medicine physician investigator about the potential clinical benefits vs. the potential risks for the fetus, in the context of the participant's medical condition, and that this discussion is documented in the nuclear medicine physician's clinical report.
